text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّۭا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّۭ وَعَرَبِىٌّۭ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًۭى وَشِفَآءٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌۭ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening an attached counterfactual reception test
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the counterfactual tied to the prior argument. The imagined foreign-language scenario is therefore a resumed test of reception: it continues the defense of revelation and exposes how objection can attach itself to whatever form the message is given.

topics.headline: resumed counterfactual test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hypothetical begins as a continuation of the dispute, not as a detached thought experiment.
topics.reason: QAC marks a prefixed conjunction before the counterfactual particle, and the CRITICAL rows consistently read it as resumption plus connection.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle staging an unreal language scenario with a predictable objection
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the foreign-recitation premise unrealized. Its span waits for the answer-lam and predicted speech, so the complaint is staged as the expected result of the hypothetical rather than a sincere neutral request.

topics.headline: unreal objection frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the foreign-language premise as an unreal test that reveals an objection pattern rather than conceding a real defect.
topics.reason: The local conditional frame governs the making verb and is answered by the emphatic speech clause, matching the CRITICAL counterfactual reading.

words.gloss_range: Form I rendering/assigning verb with attached object and resultant language-state complement
words.root_gloss_range: making, appointing, assigning, and configuring; locally a counterfactual rendering of an existing referent into a language mode
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}) carries the already disputed object by suffix and gives it a resultant recitation-and-language state. The making root supplies assignment and configuration pressure, while Form I and the two-complement frame keep the local sense to rendering an existing referent, with the Arabic-making formula reversed as a counterfactual contrast (43:3).

topics.headline: configured reception test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scenario is not creation from nothing but a divine configuration of an already identified revelation into a communicative mode.
topics.reason: The attached object plus accusative complement supports rendering or configuring; broader making branches are narrowed by the local two-complement construction.

words.gloss_range: accusative recitation/discourse classification inside the counterfactual condition
words.root_gloss_range: reading, reciting, proclaiming, and gathering into recited coherence; locally the discourse-type being hypothetically configured
words.prose: {{ar:قُرْءَانًا}} ({{tr:qurʾānan}}) functions as the result complement in the hypothetical, classifying the object as recited disclosure. The recitation field keeps the issue focused on received speech, while the indefinite accusative leaves it as a discourse mode whose Arabic-recitation formula is being inverted (12:2). The word also sits between their predicted saying and the commanded reply, so the disputed recitation is framed by competing speech acts before the authorized answer arrives.

topics.headline: recited discourse under dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed object is recited disclosure framed by competing speech acts, not merely a physical book or label.
topics.reason: Local grammar makes the noun an accusative complement, and CRITICAL recurrence rows support a narrowed recitation/discourse payoff rather than an object-format claim.

words.gloss_range: accusative nisbah adjective marking the hypothetical recitation mode as foreign or opaque
words.root_gloss_range: foreignness, non-Arabicness, and opacity; locally a marked quality of the recitation mode, not of the audience
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْجَمِيًّا}} ({{tr:aʿjamiyyan}}) agrees with the recitation noun, so the opacity claim modifies the message-mode rather than the people hearing it. Its foreignness and obscurity pressure sets up the quoted slogan that repeats the same root, and the non-Arabic-recitation refusal field shows how the objection can mutate from language opacity into a demand for detailing (26:198-199).

topics.headline: foreign opacity mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that foreignness is attached to the recitation mode, blends language difference with alleged opacity, and can then become a movable objection about detailing.
topics.reason: Case and adjective agreement keep the claim local to the recitation complement; broader ethnic readings are narrowed away from the audience.

words.gloss_range: answer-lam marking the predicted apodosis with emphatic certainty
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the answer-lam, not a preposition. It welds the unreal condition to the predicted saying and gives the complaint an emphatic inevitability inside the staged scenario.

topics.headline: emphatic predicted speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their speech is presented as structurally predictable inside the scenario, not as a surprising discovery.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as the answer marker prefixed to the speech verb, blocking ownership or benefit readings.

words.gloss_range: counterfactually modalized perfect speech verb voicing the objectors public complaint
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, and utterance; locally predicted human objection answered by commanded speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) is perfect in form but receives counterfactual force from the condition: they would have said. The verb makes the objection public and accountable, and the repeated speech root later lets the commanded answer overwrite the predicted complaint; the broader revelation-mode complaint pattern is visible in 25:32 and again within this surah at 41:15.

topics.headline: voiced objection before reply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejection becomes accountable speech, then is answered on the same speech field by the commanded reply.
topics.reason: The conditional frame supplies modal force, while local q-w-l repetition and recurrence rows support the speech-contest payoff.

words.gloss_range: reproachful why-not particle shifting the complaint to demanded detailing
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْلَا}} ({{tr:lawlā}}) turns the passive verb after it into a reproachful demand. After the foreign-language premise, the complaint relocates to why the signs were not detailed another way, showing that the criterion of objection can move.

topics.headline: movable demand for detailing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the objection moving from language to demanded segmentation, exposing dissatisfaction rather than a stable need.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the passive detailing clause, and the CRITICAL rows converge on reproach plus unrealized preferred arrangement.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect: signs are presented as recipients of detailed articulation
words.root_gloss_range: separating, deciding, distinguishing, and explaining; locally passive detailed exposition of signs
words.prose: {{ar:فُصِّلَتْ}} ({{tr:fuṣṣilat}}) makes the signs the recipients of detailed articulation while the detailing agent is left implicit. The root keeps separation, decision, and explanation together, but the Form II passive narrows the local force to segmented exposition; the demand is ironic because the surah has already described the Book this way (41:3).

topics.headline: passive detailed articulation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the objectors demand detailed signs even though this surah has already asserted that detailing (41:3).
topics.reason: Passive Form II grammar supports received detailed exposition; the active variant remains contrastive and does not replace the canonical passive.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural signs/verse-units as the passive subject of demanded detailing
words.root_gloss_range: sign, marker, and verse-unit, with contested derivational pressure toward return/refuge kept secondary; locally evidentiary textual units
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:āyātuhū}}) is the passive subject, and its suffix binds the signs to the disputed recitation itself. The plural lets the demand concern discrete textual units and proofs at once; contested root pressure can shade the kind of indicator at stake, but the local sense remains signs, and the 41:3 sequence returns as an ironic quoted demand.

topics.headline: owned sign-units under demand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the complaint targets the revelation’s own sign-units and reuses the surah-opening vocabulary against it (41:3).
topics.reason: Local passive-subject grammar and sign lexeme evidence preserve sign and verse-unit force while narrowing derivational dispute to secondary pressure.

words.gloss_range: elliptical nominative foreign/opaque label in the quoted challenge
words.root_gloss_range: foreignness and opacity; locally an abrupt relational judgment in the objection slogan
words.prose: {{ar:ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ}} ({{tr:a-aʿjamiyyun}}) appears as a compressed predicate without an overt subject. That ellipsis makes the challenge unstable: the alleged foreignness is a relational judgment from the hearer’s horizon, and its repeated root turns the earlier hypothetical quality into a quoted slogan; the smoother variant reduces the interrogative bite without changing the contrast.

topics.headline: elliptical opacity challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the slogan leaves its subject unstated, making opacity a charged relation between message, messenger, and hearer.
topics.reason: The nominative elliptical phrase supports a slogan-like predicate, while variant evidence is retained as contrast rather than control of the local parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle holding the two language labels side by side
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not explain the relationship between the two labels. It simply places foreign opacity and Arabicness side by side, so the contrast is compressed into a fragment rather than argued in a full clause.

topics.headline: compressed language contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mismatch is created by juxtaposition: the particle makes the hearer supply the alleged incoherence.
topics.reason: QAC marks coordination between nominative adjectives, and the CRITICAL rows show the contrast arising from juxtaposition.

words.gloss_range: nominative nisbah adjective naming Arabicness as language, register, and intelligibility horizon
words.root_gloss_range: Arabic expression, clarity, and affiliation; locally the clarity pole inside a compressed language contrast
words.prose: {{ar:عَرَبِىٌّ}} ({{tr:ʿarabiyyun}}) matches the foreign label as a nominative coordinated adjective, keeping the objection fragmentary. The nisbah form lets Arabicness name language, affiliation, and communicative register, so it becomes the clarity pole against which opacity is alleged; the Arabic-recitation formula in 43:3 shows why language alone cannot settle the objecting stance.

topics.headline: Arabic clarity horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Arabicness functions as a clarity horizon in the objection, not merely as an ethnic label.
topics.reason: Local coordination supports the contrast, while lexical evidence narrows Arabicness to communicative register and intelligibility rather than ethnicity alone.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperative commanding an authorized reply
words.root_gloss_range: saying and commanded speech; locally prophetic counter-speech that reclassifies the disputed revelation
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) resets the scene from reported objection to authorized answer. The imperative is brief and directive; it does not defend a language label first, but commands a reclassification of the same revelation by what it becomes for receivers, with the compact reclassification formula also recognizable at 112:1.

topics.headline: authorized reply pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sharp pivot from their predicted speech to commanded speech that reclassifies the revelation by receiver-effect.
topics.reason: Imperative grammar and q-w-l repetition support the shift from human complaint to instructed prophetic reply.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun resuming the disputed revelation as subject of new predicates
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) resumes the disputed revelation without renaming it. That continuity matters: the object questioned in the complaint becomes the subject of beneficial predicates, so the reply changes the frame from language label to receiver-based effect.

topics.headline: same referent reclassified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same object they contest is not renamed but reclassified as guidance and healing for believers.
topics.reason: Referent profiles and QAC grammar support the independent pronoun as anaphoric subject for the positive predicates.

words.gloss_range: benefactive/recipient preposition restricting realized benefit to the believing class
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) fronts the recipient class before the beneficial predicates. It does not deny that revelation is guidance; it marks where guidance and healing are realized, shifting the answer from language form to receptive stance.

topics.headline: recipient class before benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance and healing are realized for a defined receiver class, not experienced uniformly by every hearer.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative group and precedes the predicates, supporting a realized-benefit reading.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun forming the first receiver class by the following faith clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:lladhīna}}) begins the first receiver column. Its identity is supplied by the following faith-action, so the criterion shifts from language identity to receptive stance; the later repeated relative form makes the ayah read like a two-column account of reception.

topics.headline: first reception column
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply organizes reception into parallel classes rather than language identities.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the preceding preposition and is mirrored by the later relative pronoun for non-believers.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect defining those who have entered trust as the positive receiver class
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, belief, and safe relation; locally entered trust that enables guidance and healing to operate
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) defines the beneficiaries as those who have entered trust. The security field of the root makes faith more than cognition, while Form IV and the relative clause keep the local point to a receptive relation in which guidance and healing take effect; the same trust root later divides the negative column into blocked sensory reception. The healing-for-hearts field is concrete at 10:57.

topics.headline: trust opens benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that benefit depends on a trust relation, not merely on hearing the words or knowing the language.
topics.reason: Perfect Form IV in the relative clause supports entered trust; broader security associations are narrowed to the receiver condition for the positive predicates.

words.gloss_range: indefinite guidance predicate: open-ended direction and orientation for believers
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, direction, and wayfinding; locally realized orientation from the revelation
words.prose: {{ar:هُدًى}} ({{tr:hudan}}) classifies the revelation by quality and function, not as one bounded instruction. It names directional benefit first, before remedy, and it stands opposite the blindness predicate later in the ayah; the same guidance/blindness opposition has already been sharpened in this surah (41:17), and the restricted guidance formula is familiar from 2:2.

topics.headline: guidance as orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply shifts from language complaint to whether the receiver can be oriented and led by the revelation.
topics.reason: Indefinite predicate grammar and local opposition to blindness support guidance as open-ended orientation realized for the receiver class.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle pairing guidance and healing as simultaneous benefits
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the second positive predicate under the same pronoun. The result is a benefit field in which the same discourse both orients and repairs receptive hearers.

topics.headline: paired benefit predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direction and remedy are two functions of the same revelation, not separate stages or separate texts.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two nominative predicates of the same subject, supporting simultaneous benefit rather than sequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite healing predicate: remedy and repair realized in receptive believers
words.root_gloss_range: healing, curing, and restoration, with brink/edge pressure secondary; locally revelatory remedy paired with guidance
words.prose: {{ar:شِفَاءٌ}} ({{tr:shifāʾun}}) adds remedy to direction. Its indefinite predicate form classifies the revelation as healing in quality, while the root dispute can let brink imagery hover as danger-from-which-one-is-recovered without replacing cure; the Qurʾanic healing field at 10:57 and 17:82 is narrowed here to believers. As a marked healing predicate, it also carries the previous forgiveness-and-remission field into receiver-level repair.

topics.headline: marked revelatory remedy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply treats rejection as a condition needing repair, with a marked healing predicate carrying prior forgiveness-and-remission pressure into receiver-level remedy.
topics.reason: Local predicate grammar selects healing/remedy, while contested edge pressure is preserved only as secondary lexical coloring.

words.gloss_range: clause-opening conjunction pivoting to the opposite receiver class
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the negative reception column while keeping the same revelation in view. The contrast is built by juxtaposition rather than by an explicit adversative particle, so the two groups remain structurally comparable.

topics.headline: contrastive reception pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning to the negative column without changing the subject of revelation.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the second relative group and creates local contrast through parallel structure.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun forming the second receiver class by negated faith
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) forms the second receiver class before the sensory diagnosis arrives. It mirrors the first relative head, but the following clause flips the defining stance from faith to non-faith, not ethnicity, language ability, or mere exposure.

topics.headline: second reception column
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second group is defined by refusal of trust, not by ethnicity, language ability, or exposure.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the topic of the negative clause and mirrors the earlier relative construction.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over ongoing imperfect faith
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) scopes over the imperfect faith verb. It turns the repeated trust root into the exact inverse of the believer column and prepares the movement from non-trust to blocked perception.

topics.headline: ongoing non-trust negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative group is defined by a continuing refusal, not by a single past lapse.
topics.reason: QAC marks negation of the imperfect verb, and polarity profiles support the categorical contrast.

words.gloss_range: negated Form IV imperfect naming ongoing non-entry into trust
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and belief withheld; locally continuing refusal that leads into sensory blockage
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūn}}) lacks an explicit object, so under negation it names a continuing stance of non-trust in the revelation context. The security field of the root collapses under negation, and the ayah immediately maps that refusal into sensory obstruction; the ear-blocking motif is concrete at 6:25.

topics.headline: non-trust becomes blockage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same trust root divides access to one discourse: refusal becomes blocked ears, blindness, and remote address.
topics.reason: Negated Form IV imperfect grammar supports ongoing refusal, while the following sensory predicates keep the security field locally tied to reception failure.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing obstruction inside the hearing channel
words.prose: {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) locates the obstruction in the ears before the obstruction is named. The containment image internalizes failed reception: the defect belongs to the hearing channel of the receivers, not to the message.

topics.headline: blockage inside receiver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is located in the receiver’s ear-channel, not in the revelation itself.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the ears phrase and the fronted locative precedes the delayed obstruction predicate.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural ears as the bodily site of reception blockage
words.root_gloss_range: ear, hearing, announcement, and permission/access; locally the receivers own hearing channels
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاذَانِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ādhānihim}}) names the owned hearing channel governed by the locative. The suffix localizes the fault in the non-believing group, while the ear root also suggests access or permission; the same ear-weight refusal scene appears earlier in this surah (41:5) and prepares the final image of being called from afar.

topics.headline: owned hearing channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blockage is localized in their own hearing channels and anticipates the final call that still reaches them as remote.
topics.reason: Local genitive government and possessive suffix support receiver-localized blockage; broader permission associations are narrowed to access pressure in the hearing image.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun for ear-heaviness: an unmeasured obstructive weight
words.root_gloss_range: heaviness, weight, burden, settled dignity; locally obstructive weight lodged in ears
words.prose: {{ar:وَقْرٌ}} ({{tr:waqrun}}) arrives after the ear-location has been named, as the weight lodged there. The root image makes non-reception feel like a load inside the hearing channel, not generic deafness; parallels at 31:7 and 6:25 keep the motif tied to refusing reception.

topics.headline: weighted hearing obstruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hearing is pictured as loaded down, so the problem is burdened reception rather than absence of sound.
topics.reason: Indefinite predicate grammar and the ear collocation support obstructive heaviness, while broader dignity or honor branches are not locally selected.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining hearing blockage with blindness as simultaneous diagnoses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the blindness clause to the ear-heaviness clause without making it a later stage. The diagnosis expands from hearing to sight, turning rejection into a broad perceptual failure.

topics.headline: linked sensory failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices non-reception widening from one blocked organ to a full sensory field.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two sensory predicates, and local discourse structure treats them as simultaneous effects.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun resuming the same revelation for the negative predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) resumes the same revelation named by the earlier pronoun, but now the predicate field reverses. The object is not changed or renamed; the receiver relation changes, so the same discourse is experienced as blindness upon them.

topics.headline: same object adverse effect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the identical revelation becomes guidance and healing for one group but blindness upon another.
topics.reason: Referent profiles support the pronoun chain, and the repeated nominal frame sharpens the receiver-dependent reversal.

words.gloss_range: fronted adverse prepositional phrase placing blindness upon the receivers
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) is fronted before the blindness predicate, centering the affected group under pressure. The preposition makes blindness rest upon or against them, heavier than a neutral internal state.

topics.headline: blindness upon them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blindness as an adverse burden laid upon the receivers before the predicate is named.
topics.reason: QAC marks the prepositional phrase as fronted complement of the blindness predicate, supporting adverse overlying force.

words.gloss_range: indefinite blindness predicate: settled interpretive incapacity opposed to guidance
words.root_gloss_range: blindness, obscured sight, and loss of evidence-perception; locally imposed perceptual incapacity toward revelation
words.prose: {{ar:عَمًى}} ({{tr:ʿaman}}) is an indefinite noun predicate, making blindness a state imposed upon them rather than a single event. The sight-loss image becomes interpretive incapacity toward signs, and it directly reverses guidance; the verbal variant would make the blindness more eventive, while the local noun leaves it as predicate, with 17:72 and 41:17 sharpening the field.

topics.headline: guidance reversed as blindness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guide is present, but rejecting receivers cannot perceive the route; guidance is answered by blindness.
topics.reason: Nominal predicate grammar selects a state; variant evidence is retained as contrast and broader blindness recurrence is narrowed to revelation-reception here.

words.gloss_range: resumptive demonstrative gathering the diagnosed group for the closing distance image
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) points back to the non-believing group after the sensory diagnosis. Its deictic distance suits the closing image: those already blocked in hearing and sight are gathered as the ones being called from far away.

topics.headline: diagnosed group summed up
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior diagnosis gathered into a final verdict-like scene of remote calling.
topics.reason: The demonstrative resumes the diagnosed group and launches the passive calling predicate.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect calling verb: ongoing address experienced across distance
words.root_gloss_range: calling, summoning, and address across separation; locally passive ongoing being-called by a remote-seeming call
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَادَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yunādawna}}) suppresses the caller and foregrounds the addressees experience of being addressed. As a passive imperfect it presents ongoing or repeated calling, while the prior ear-heaviness turns the call into communicative remoteness; calling across separated groups at 7:44 provides a concrete parallel for distance without making absence of address the problem.

topics.headline: ongoing remote address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is not silence: a call continues, but blocked receivers experience it as remote.
topics.reason: Passive imperfect grammar supports ongoing being-called; root and recurrence evidence are narrowed to the local remote-reception scene.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking the far place as origin of the experienced call
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks the source of the calling scene. The far place is where the call seems to come from, so the final problem is perceived separation from address rather than silence.

topics.headline: source of remote call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call has an origin from which it is experienced as distant, rather than the addressees being simply abandoned.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the place phrase and supplies the origin for the passive calling.

words.gloss_range: indefinite place noun forming the unspecified source-location of the remote call
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, place, and located existence; locally an unspecified locus that spatializes failed reception
words.prose: {{ar:مَّكَانٍ}} ({{tr:makānin}}) is governed by the source preposition and modified by the distance adjective, forming the final source phrase. Its indefiniteness makes remoteness more important than geography, while the call-from-place pattern at 19:52 is reversed into estrangement; the assimilated sound in the source phrase fuses the words acoustically even as the meaning names distance.

topics.headline: spatialized reception failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices misunderstanding becoming spatial: the call has a locus, but the receivers experience it beyond effective reach.
topics.reason: Local genitive government and adjective modification support place as source-locus; broader being-root values are narrowed to the place noun in this scene.

words.gloss_range: indefinite distance adjective defining the source place by unmeasured remoteness
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, separation, and estrangement; locally perceptual and relational distance from the call
words.prose: {{ar:بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}) agrees with the indefinite place noun and makes distance the defining quality of the call source. The remoteness is unmeasured and perceptual as much as spatial: ear-heaviness and blindness culminate in relational distance, and the ayah’s opening opacity is relocated into receiver alienation; 22:53 supplies a concrete far-schism field for the same distance pressure.

topics.headline: unmeasured remote call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not with no call, but with revelation heard as far away by blocked receivers.
topics.reason: Adjective agreement and final position support remoteness as the closing property; broader distance fields are narrowed to the experienced distance of address.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual making of a non-Arabic Quran, the demand that its signs be detailed, and the Arabic/non-Arabic pairing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counterfactual assigns the Quran a state of non-clarity, then anticipates a demand for differentiated meaning while making the Arabic/non-Arabic pairing itself objectionable. Changing the code therefore does not by itself end the objection.

activation_trace.role: Making as assignment of a state supplies the counterfactual recoding of the Quran.
Recitation identifies the object whose communicative form is being varied.
Lack of clear, intelligible expression supplies the alleged opacity.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings supplies the demanded remedy.
Clear expression supplies the opposite pole whose pairing is nevertheless challenged.

changed_reading.before: A foreign-language Quran would merely require translation or fuller explanation.
changed_reading.after: The hypothetical stages an objection that survives a change of code: opacity is demanded away, yet the Arabic/non-Arabic relation itself becomes the next objection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same Quran is guidance and healing for believers, but ear-weight and blindness for those who do not believe.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated contrast in belief conditions the effect of one recitation. Trust opens a route for orientation and repair; refusal turns the receiving organs into sites of load and occlusion.

activation_trace.role: Secure repose and trust supply the receptive condition on one side of the contrast.
Gentle indication toward a route supplies orientation rather than mere information.
Cure and restoration supply a second, reparative effect.
Listening as attentive acceptance makes the ear a relational channel, not only an organ.
Weight lodged in the ear converts the receiving channel into an impediment.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies non-visual occlusion over the hearers.

changed_reading.before: The Quran has a uniform informational effect that some people simply miss.
changed_reading.after: One recitation bifurcates through reception: trust lets it orient and restore, while refusal converts hearing and insight into burden and occlusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ear-weight, blindness over them, and being called from a distant place form one sensory-spatial sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A call normally projects voice across a range, but burdened hearing and blinded insight make its point of origin feel unreachable. Sensory closure is rendered as spatial separation.

activation_trace.role: Ear-weight supplies the immediate blockage that precedes the distance image.
Blind insight extends blockage from acoustics to interpretation.
The reach and range of a raised voice convert failed reception into a distance problem.
Place and station give the reception failure a spatial coordinate.
Distance from proximity names the experienced separation.

changed_reading.before: The final image describes a caller who is physically remote.
changed_reading.after: Blocked listening and insight manufacture remoteness: a call is present, yet the receiver experiences it as arriving from an unreachable station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Quran, detailed signs, and the contrast between opacity and clear expression.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Quran gathers recitable units, detailing separates components until their boundaries show, and signs mark what is to be recognized. Communication here alternates integration and differentiation rather than merely adding explanation.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining supply the integrated side of the textual architecture.
Separation until a boundary appears supplies the differentiating operation.
Exposition of parts and meanings makes differentiation semantic as well as formal.
A manifest marker supplies recognizable nodes within the gathered recitation.

changed_reading.before: Detailed verses simply means that more explanation was wanted.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is an organized signal of gathered recitation, separated components, and manifest markers; opacity can arise from failure to integrate distinctions already made visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening first presents a detailed Arabic Quran for people who know, then moves through turning away, not hearing, ear-weight, and a barrier. The focus ayah repeats that vocabulary under a foreign-language counterfactual, converting the opening refusal into a diagnosis rather than a code defect.

activation_trace.role: The focus ear-weight is the terminal state whose earlier formation the opening sequence supplies.
The already-present detailing of parts and meanings contradicts the imagined absence of detail.
The same recited object establishes a direct lexical reprise.
Clear expression is supplied before the later hypothetical complaint about foreignness.
Turning the side away supplies an active break in reception after clarity is presented.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes 'not hearing' more than failed acoustics.
The exact earlier ear-weight shows that the focus image resumes a declared posture.
A barrier that prevents access spatializes the self-described separation.

structural_cues: 41:3 states the detailed-Arabic-Quran complex that 41:44 counterfactually varies.
41:4-5 move immediately from turning away and not hearing to ear-weight and a barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence and sequence; I infer that 41:44 replays the opening as a diagnosis of reception. A live alternative is that it is an independent summary rather than a deliberate return.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah poses an isolated foreign-language hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: It returns to the surah's opening experiment: an actually detailed Arabic recitation was followed by refusal and self-described barriers, so imagined foreignness exposes a complaint insensitive to the form supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to listen to this Quran is paired with producing mixed noise inside its hearing-space for the purpose of gaining dominance. Ear-weight in the focus can therefore be socially manufactured interference, not only an involuntary deficit.

activation_trace.role: Ear-weight supplies the apparent incapacity that the earlier tactic reclassifies.
Voice range supplies the signal that interference makes seem remote.
Hearing as understanding and compliance is explicitly prohibited.
The tactic targets the same recited Quran named in the focus.
Mixed, clamorous sound supplies an active masking field around the recitation.
Overpowering force supplies the strategic motive for the noise.

structural_cues: 41:26 links a negative listening imperative, a noise imperative, and a purpose clause of dominance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the anti-listening tactic and its purpose; I infer that this tactic helps produce the focus ayah's burdened hearing and distance. It may characterize organized opponents more directly than every individual nonbeliever.

changed_reading.before: The nonbelievers cannot hear because their ears are impaired.
changed_reading.after: Their hearing-space is deliberately occupied by noise in order to overpower the recitation; the resulting ear-weight is enacted resistance that later feels like distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah has already placed guidance and blindness together under a verb of preference: guidance is supplied, yet blindness is loved instead. The focus contrast is thus not merely two audience labels but two attachments competing at the point of reception.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward the route is the offered pole of the focus contrast.
Blindness of insight is the opposed state laid over the rejecting audience.
Supplied guidance confirms that the route was made available before rejection.
Heart-attached love supplies the directional preference between the two states.
Blindness of insight is explicitly selected over guidance.

structural_cues: 41:17 places guidance, preference, blindness, and guidance again in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit preference in 41:17; I infer that it sharpens the focus audience split into an attachment-based choice. A live alternative is that the historical example should not be generalized to every rejecting hearer.

changed_reading.before: Belief and unbelief are static categories that determine two effects.
changed_reading.after: The categories expose rival attachments: a route is supplied, but blindness can be preferred and then experienced as if it were imposed by the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skin later testify about works, and failed concealment is tied to a mistaken supposition about being known. The focus ear-weight and blindness therefore need not mean missing sensory data; the organs receive enough to become evidence against their owners.

activation_trace.role: Attentive acceptance is the function denied at the focus ear-channel.
Blind insight anchors the distinction between sensory possession and interpretive reception.
Presence with witnessing makes the organs evidentiary agents.
The faculty of sound perception remains available to testify.
Visual perception joins hearing as retained evidence.
The body's outer covering broadens testimony beyond the named distance senses.
Attempted covering supplies the failed strategy that testimony defeats.
Uncertain supposition supplies the interpretive error behind the concealment.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 repeat hearing, sight, and skin while moving from testimony to failed concealment and mistaken supposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies functioning organs that testify; I infer that the focus blockage is moral-interpretive rather than absence of exposure. A live alternative is that eschatological testimony is miraculous and says little about present comprehension.

changed_reading.before: Ear-weight and blindness mean that evidence never entered the senses.
changed_reading.after: The senses can retain enough to testify while their owners refuse attentive acceptance; blockage lies between perception and acknowledged meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The best speech calls toward God and is followed by repelling harm with what is better, which turns an enemy into a near, supportive intimate. The focus pair of guidance and healing can therefore include repair of a damaged relation and closure of interpersonal distance.

activation_trace.role: Healing anchors the transfer from bodily repair to repair of an antagonistic relation.
Distance supplies the relational condition that the better response can reverse.
Voiced speech supplies the medium through which the restorative sequence begins.
Calling by speech supplies directed invitation rather than coercion.
Pushing away harm supplies the active therapeutic operation.
An enemy relation supplies the wound-like starting state.
Proximity without an interval supplies the reversal of distance.
Close kinship supplies the warmth and intimacy of the repaired endpoint.

structural_cues: 41:33-35 move from good speech and calling to a reversal from enemy to intimate, then name patience as the capacity to receive it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a causal relational reversal; I infer that the focus term 'healing' can include social repair. A live alternative keeps healing individual or spiritual and treats 41:34 as a separate ethical instruction.

changed_reading.before: Healing names an inward benefit delivered to an individual believer.
changed_reading.after: Healing can operate between persons: guided speech and a better response close hostile distance until an enemy relation is repaired into intimacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is introduced as a descent, while a later sign makes descended water enter humbled earth, set it moving, make it grow, and restore life. This material sequence sharpens guidance and healing as revived receptivity rather than only instruction and cure.

activation_trace.role: Guidance anchors the restored capacity to move along a route.
Healing anchors restoration from an inert or damaged condition.
Delivery by descent supplies the revelation side of the material analogy.
The same delivery-by-descent image introduces water into the receptive surface.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the restorative input.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life supplies the first changed state.
Nourishment and growth supply the sustained effect after stirring.
The earth's life through rain makes restoration explicit.

structural_cues: The root of descent frames both the opening revelation and the water event in 41:39.
41:39 is itself introduced as a sign and gives a visible input-to-revival sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated descent root and the explicit water-to-life sequence; I map that material sequence onto Quranic healing. A live alternative reads 41:39 only as a resurrection demonstration.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gives directions and healing removes an illness.
changed_reading.after: The descended recitation can be imaged as water entering a receptive surface, restoring movement, growth, and life; failure is then non-absorption as much as non-comprehension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier rejecters answer human messengers by demanding angels, the same kind of saying is described as preceding the present messenger, and the immediately following ayah recalls a book that became disputed. The focus language complaint is one movable medium-demand within a recurring refusal pattern.

activation_trace.role: The foreign or unintelligible code supplies the medium variable changed in the focus.
A saying that circulates among people supplies the objection as a repeatable social script.
Messengers and message-bearing supply the rejected human medium.
Angelic agency supplies the demanded substitute medium.
Covering the truth persists after the substitute is demanded.
Recurring public discourse supplies the transhistorical repetition of objections.
Temporal precedence places the current saying after earlier instances.
A prior written revelation supplies a cross-medium comparison.
Taking divergent paths supplies disagreement around the delivered book.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty supply the reception state after dispute.

structural_cues: 41:14 and 41:44 both use counterfactual substitution to voice a demand for a different medium.
41:43 immediately precedes the focus with repeated sayings, and 41:45 immediately follows it with dispute over an earlier book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated medium substitutions and adjacent historical recurrence; I infer an objection that relocates whenever one form is supplied. Different historical groups may still have had distinct, sincere complaints.

changed_reading.before: The problem is a specific mismatch between Arabic and a hypothetical foreign Quran.
changed_reading.after: Language is one replaceable variable in a recurring objection generator that can demand angels instead of humans, another code instead of this code, and still dispute a delivered book.

context_deltas.mechanism: When receiving favor, the human turns away and moves his side to a distance; when harm touches him, his own call becomes broad. The focus call from far away is thereby recast as asymmetric control of communicative distance: withdrawal while addressed, expansion while requesting.

activation_trace.role: Voice range anchors the focus problem of a call experienced across distance.
Distance anchors the location that the receiver may help produce.
Turning the side away resolves the receiving member of the paired behavior.
Breadth resolves the later description of the sender's own extended prayer.
Moving far away supplies intentional increase of receiving distance.
Withdrawal and estrangement by the side supplies bodily enactment of distance.
A voiced call supplies the expansive outgoing demand that contrasts with withdrawn reception.

structural_cues: 41:51 balances two conditional states and pivots on the same root between turning away and broad prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily withdrawal and later expansive calling; I infer a failure of communicative reciprocity. A live alternative reads the pair only as a general portrait of ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: The distant call is a passive condition imposed on a deficient hearer.
changed_reading.after: The hearer helps set the distance: he withdraws when addressed but projects a broad call when he needs an answer, making remoteness asymmetrical and self-produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus distance reappears as distant schism, then signs span horizons and selves until truth becomes manifest, and finally everything is encompassed. The call's source is not outside the evidence-field; the rejecting receiver occupies a divided position inside an enclosing field of signs.

activation_trace.role: The range of a call supplies the focus image whose geometry is revised.
Distance from proximity provides the lexical bridge into the later schism.
A group split by opposition converts remoteness into relational division.
A distant tract gives the division an extended spatial image.
The exact distance root identifies the later state as the focus image's lexical return.
Far horizons extend signs across the outermost visible field.
The self itself supplies the inward evidence-field opposite the horizons.
Emergence into manifestness supplies the eventual disclosure of truth.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession closes the geometry around every receiver.

structural_cues: 41:52 repeats the focus word for distance inside 'distant schism.'
41:53 expands signs from horizons to selves, and 41:54 closes with total encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and enclosing sequence; I infer that remoteness belongs primarily to the receiver's schismatic position. The focus still permits a straightforward physical-distance simile.

changed_reading.before: The revelation fails to reach because it comes from too far away.
changed_reading.after: The receiver stands far within a split while signs remain outside, inside, and all around; distance names estrangement inside an encompassing address, not absence of the address.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later call summons the rejecters to identify alleged partners; their answer acknowledges notification and the absence of any witness. This converts calling from mere transmission into a forensic event where hearing, answering, and evidence become accountable acts.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling anchors the focus communication that the later scene judicially sharpens.
Attentive acceptance anchors the responsibility attached to hearing.
A directed raised call initiates the later demand for an answer.
The alleged divine partnership supplies the proposition put under examination.
Knowing and formally notifying by proclamation supplies the responsive acknowledgment.
A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the witness they cannot produce.

structural_cues: 41:47 repeats the focus call root three ayat later and immediately stages question, answer, notification, and witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated call and evidentiary exchange; I infer that the focus call carries a summons-like pressure. A live alternative treats the repeated verb as ordinary calling without deliberate foreshadowing.

changed_reading.before: Calling from afar is only a metaphor for failed communication.
changed_reading.after: The call also anticipates a summons: what was held at auditory distance returns as a demand to answer, notify, and produce a witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the chewing-and-testing and tested-hardness branches of the focus root for non-Arabicness. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root and the voiced objection, but downstream prose should present it as a material stress-test analogy, never as the lexical meaning of 'non-Arabic.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated non-Arabic root inside a counterfactual followed by objection and answer.

activation_trace.role: Biting or chewing an object to test it supplies a material image for the counterfactual probe.
Hardness revealed under testing supplies what the imagined code-change exposes in the objectors.
Voiced objection and answer make the result of the probe audible.

changed_reading.before: The foreign-language scenario is a straightforward communication hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: It can also function as a stress test: the imagined recoding is bitten against, and the resulting objection reveals the receiver's hardness rather than the message's weakness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the hidden-pit branch of the non-Arabic root and a later botanical-birth sequence. It remains anchored to the focus opacity term and packet-local images of fruit, casing, inner carrying, and emergence; render it only as a secondary material analogy, not as a claim that opacity is intrinsically fertile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus term for non-Arabic opacity and the Quran's gathered, detailed signs.

activation_trace.role: A hidden pit inside what is eaten supplies an opaque exterior with a concealed generative core.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from hidden to manifest.
Ripe fruit supplies the visible product around an inner kernel.
A plant vessel and fruit casing supplies the enclosing layer.
Inner carrying and fruit-bearing supplies latent content before emergence.

changed_reading.before: Opacity is simply an absence of accessible meaning.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the packet's material imagery, opacity can resemble a casing around latent content whose emergence requires a receptive process.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates wetness, rain, and generosity within the focus call root. It remains anchored to the actual call and healing terms and is reinforced by the packet's descended-water revival scene; downstream prose should mark it as a branch echo, not replace the ordinary sense of raised voice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The call from a distant place beside guidance and healing.

activation_trace.role: Dew, rain, and moisture recast the call as a potentially restorative medium.
Generosity and giving make the projected call a gift rather than only a sound.
Healing anchors the restorative value assigned to the moisture image.
Delivered water supplies the context mechanism by which the call-image can restore.
Earth stirring into life supplies the effect of receiving the restorative medium.

changed_reading.before: The distant call is only a voice whose words cannot be made out.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the call can resemble far-cast moisture or generosity: healing is offered across distance, but only a receptive surface stirs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant packet mapping of the guidance root to severe breaking and demolition. It remains anchored to focus guidance and healing and gains limited support from repelling harm and removing falsehood; render it as an exploratory subtractive model, not as a gloss of 'guidance.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Guidance and healing as paired effects of the Quran.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply a subtractive, obstacle-removing image for guidance.
Healing constrains demolition to removal in service of restoration.
Pushing away harm supplies a context instance of restorative subtraction.
Removing what lacks truth supplies the obstruction-clearing endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Guidance adds directions and healing adds wholeness.
changed_reading.after: In a contained subtractive reading, guidance-healing may first break and repel structures that block the route, restoring by removal before adding orientation.

strongest_changes: The focus ayah replays the opening's detailed Arabic Quran, refusal to hear, ear-weight, and barrier as a reception diagnosis.
The anti-listening command in 41:26 turns ear-weight from passive incapacity into strategically manufactured interference.
The preference for blindness in 41:17 makes guidance and blindness rival attachments rather than merely assigned outcomes.
The withdrawal and broad prayer of 41:51 expose asymmetric control of communicative distance.
The distant schism, horizon-and-self signs, and final encompassing in 41:52-54 relocate distance inside an enclosing field of evidence.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence links language, hearing, sight, calling, and distance tightly enough to shift the focus from a code-choice problem into several coexisting reception mechanisms: strategic noise, preferred blindness, failed reciprocity, social repair, material revival, and eventual summons.
remaining_uncertainties: The final distant-place image may retain a primarily physical simile even when the later distant schism supports relational distance.
The explicit preference in 41:17 may diagnose a historical example more narrowly than the full focus audience.
The relational-healing and rain-revival models depend on cross-domain transfer rather than explicit equations in the packet.
The testing, hidden-kernel, dewy-call, and demolition branches are deliberately retained as exploratory and should not be promoted into lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The alleged language problem is exposed as a reception problem.** **ع ج م B001** gives lack of clear articulation; **ع ر ب B001** clear disclosure; **ف ص ل B013** clarifying detail; **و ق ر B001/B002** ear-heaviness and borne weight; **ع م ي B002** blindness of insight. The hypothetical reverses the language and preserves the objection, then locates failure in ears and insight. I infer that linguistic form is being used as a movable pretext for fixed nonreception.
2. **One discourse becomes guidance/healing or weight/blindness according to relation.** **ه د ي B001/B002** supplies guidance and directed course; **ش ف ي B001** healing and relief; **ء م ن B001** secure trust. The same referent is coordinated with opposite effects. I infer that the discourse does not mechanically impose one outcome; receptive relation converts it into route and repair, while refusal converts contact into load and opacity.
3. **Distance is produced inside communication.** **ن د و B002** gives raised calling and **ب ع د B001/B003** remoteness and created separation. They are called, yet from a far place. I infer that ear-weight and blindness generate functional distance despite audible address. The ayah reads as failed proximity, not absent signal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:52 repeats “far” as distant schism, confirming that communicative distance is an enacted stance. 41:53 counters it with signs at both outer horizons and inner selves, collapsing the excuse that the call's source is too remote.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The language objection reveals receiver-produced distance.** Lexically, `ع ج م B001` is lack of clear articulation, `ع ر ب B001` clear disclosure, `ف ص ل B013` clarifying detail, `و ق ر B001` ear-blocking heaviness, `ع م ي B002` blindness of insight, `ن د و B002` a voice-call and its reach, and `ب ع د B001` remoteness. Structurally, the hypothetical asks for clarification if the recitation were non-articulate, but the actual clear articulation is followed by ear weight, blindness, and a call experienced as distant. I assign language the offered explanatory pretext and the sensory blocks the actual distance-producing mechanism. The causal arrow from blocked reception to experienced remoteness is inferred from the sequence. The ayah reads “far place” as a relational condition manufactured at the receiver, not merely geographic separation.

2. **The same discourse routes and repairs.** `ه د ي B001` is guidance toward a way or truth and `ش ف ي B001` healing/relief. These paired roles stand opposite the paired ear-weight and blindness, while 41:39 has just modeled water turning dormant ground into life. I assign guidance the role of restoring direction and healing the role of repairing the damaged receptive faculty. The regenerative analogy is abductive but locally activated. The Qurʾan consequently reads as an intervention on the receiver, not information whose effect is constant regardless of condition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:48’s vanished invoked objects and 41:49’s unwearied prayer made “calling from far away” decisively relational: calls fail or proliferate according to the caller’s orientation, not because sound lacks reach.

baseline.text: Onu yabancı dilde bir Kur'an yapsaydık, Ayetleri açıklansaydı ya! Yabancı dilde bir Kur'an ve Arap biri mi? derlerdi. De ki: O, inananlar için doğru yol gösterici ve şifadır. İnanmayanların kulaklarında bir ağırlık vardır ve o onlara karşı bir körlüktür. Onlara uzak bir yerden sesleniliyor.

findings.text: Yabancı dil itirazının varsayım değişse de sürmesi, dilin hareketli bir bahane olduğunu; gerçek uzaklığın kulaktaki yük ve iç görüşteki körlük tarafından üretildiğini gösterir.
Aynı söylem, alıcıyla kurulan ilişkiye göre hem yönü onaran bir kılavuz hem de alıcıdaki hasarı iyileştiren bir müdahale olur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A concealed capacity becomes visible life when an inward medium enters, disturbs, and nourishes it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The revived field opens into a parallel gestational mechanism in which seminal water enters a containing organ and develops hidden life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gestational Water and Inward Growth

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: seminal water placed in a womb `quranic:root_001458:B004/m01`; emitted generative fluid `quranic:root_001492:B009/m01`; womb gathering a pregnancy `quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`; nourishment and development of a child `quranic:root_000537:B005/m01`; concealed reproductive organ or womb `quranic:root_000383:B011/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The same roots that describe descent, water, swelling, and life assemble a gestational analogue. Containment and nourishment explain how hidden potential can pass through an inward phase before it becomes perceptible growth.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering language into a recitable whole `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading and recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; ordered letters and written artifact `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; adding points that disambiguate script `quranic:root_000988:B002/m01`; inarticulate or foreign speech `quranic:root_000988:B001/m01`; clear Arabic expression `quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`; adapting a foreign name to Arabic form `quranic:root_000996:B019/m01`; textual separators `quranic:root_001159:B011/m01`; detailing and distinguishing parts `quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`; articulating tongue `quranic:root_001159:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Foreignness and clarity are mediated by the concrete work of pointing, separating, reading, and voicing. The text becomes intelligible through an engineered relation between graphic distinction and articulated speech.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gentle guidance to a route `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; leading guide at the front `quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`; cure that removes illness `quranic:root_000806:B001/m01`; heaviness in the ear `quranic:root_001674:B001/m01`; blindness of the eye `quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`; unmarked land in which one cannot navigate `quranic:root_001049:B006/m01`; far distance `quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`; projected summons `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; listening that accepts `quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye yapacağı iş veya yerine getireceği görev karşılığında ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağanı açıkça tanımlar. İnsanların bir sefer veya önemli iş için aralarında kararlaştırdıkları ortak ödemeler de aynı karşılık belirleme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iş veya görev karşılığında belirlenen ödemedir; genel armağanı, yapılan işi, durum değiştirmeyi ve tencere bezini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad alanına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yapacağı iş veya görev karşılığında ona verilmek üzere belirlenen ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır. Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş için aralarında kararlaştırdığı ödemeler de bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir iş veya görevin yapılması karşılığında bir kişiye ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır.
Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş sırasında kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödemeleri de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iş karşılığında önceden ayrılan ücret veya armağanda birleşir; topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeler bu çekirdeğin özel biçimi olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: iş karşılığı belirlenen ücret veya ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödeme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir kişiye iş için ayrılan karşılığı hem de bir topluluğun önemli iş için kararlaştırdığı ödeme biçimini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: İşe bağlı karşılık belirleme ile ortak ödeme özel durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işi üstlenecek kişiye vaat edilen ücret veya ödülün anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödeme özel durumunu dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.loses: Tek bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapması için ayrılan bireysel ücret biçimini dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söz konusu biçimi doğrudan deve kuşunun yavrusu olarak açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu hayvan türü ve yaşam evresi ayrımını eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır; genel yavru, başka kuş yavrusu veya deve yavrusu anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımına dayanır ve herhangi bir özel söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır.

facets.statement: Türü deve kuşu olan genç yavruyu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adın deve kuşunun yavrusunu bildirdiği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız deve kuşunun genç yavrusu adlandırıldığında eksiksiz ve doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü ve yavruluk evresini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlı bir cümlede deve kuşunun yavrusundan söz edilirken doğal sözcük sırasını sağlar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve kuşu türünü ve yavruluk durumunu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız deve kuşu yavrusunu adlandıran tek anlamlı kullanım burada esastır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deve kuşu yavrusunun yanında küçük develeri ve hizmetçileri de kapsayan daha geniş bir anlam kümesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: deve kuşu yavruları ve başka topluluklar
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırma alanında iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütünüyle deve kuşu yavrusuna bağlıdır; komşu dal aynı karşılığın yanında tür ve insan bakımından başka anlamlara da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavruluğu özellikle deve kuşu türüne bağlayan özel bir addır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan, evcil hayvan ve yabanıl hayvan yavrularını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğumdan sonraki genç ve küçük yaşam evresini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür bakımından özeldir; komşu dal pek çok canlı türünün yavrusunu içine alan genel sınıf adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; çok anlamlı yakın ad ile genel yavru adı, tür ve kapsam sınırlarını en yararlı biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعول بمعنى الرأل، ولد النعام.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل الدويبة ولا الجعل النخل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعول ولد النعام (maqayis)؛ الجعول الرأل ولد النعام (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sözün bir yer adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir ve bundan başka bir yer kimliği veya genel anlam vermez. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırlı tanıklığı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adın gösterdiği belirli yer açıklanmadığı için tanım bir yer kimliği uydurmaz ve sözü genel yer anlamına dönüştürmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli ad biçimine bağlıdır; genel veya yalın bir yer anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Kaynağın yalnızca bir yer adı olduğunu bildirdiği, gösterdiği yer açıklanmayan özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kimliği belirtilmeyen bir yer için kullanılan özel addır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu kullanım tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlıdır ve yerin kimliğine ilişkin ek bir ortak açıklama bulunmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynağın belirli yer kimliğini açıklamadan yalnızca yer adı diye sınıflandırdığı bu özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adı olma bilgisini ve yer kimliğinin belirtilmemiş oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün genel yer anlamı taşımadığı, yalnız özel ad olarak kullanıldığı açıklanırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü kimliği belirtilmemiş özel bir yer adı olarak korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; adayların her biri başka ve belirli bir yer adını veya genel yer alanını gösterir, ancak odak adın hangi yerle özdeş olduğunu kanıtlamaz; bu yüzden yayımlanabilir bir karşıtlık seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعلة حين يصرح المصدر بأنها اسم مكان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعلة الواحدة من النخل الصغار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجَعْلة اسم مكان (maqayis)

source_note.MQ: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç nitelik birlikte kurucudur; yalnız kısa, yalnız şişman veya yalnız inatçı olan biri bu dalın tam kapsamına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın betimleyici kullanıma dayanır ve özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını anlatan nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Kısa, şişman ve tartışmada inatla direnen kişiyi üç niteliği birlikte taşıyarak betimler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu birleşik kişi betimlemesi tek bir tanıklığa dayanır; kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte verilir.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişide beden kısalığı, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte anlatıldığında tam karşılık verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçılığın birlikte bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üç niteliği birlikte taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi belirleyen üç kurucu niteliğin tümünü birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şişmanlık ile tartışmada inatla direnme niteliklerini kısalıkla birlikte gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalın, güçlü ve toplu beden yapısını bildirir, fakat inatçılığı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kısa ve toplu beden yapısına sahip kişiyi betimlemede iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel kısalık ve şişmanlığa davranışsal inatçılığı ekler; komşu dal ise bedensel kalınlık ve gücü öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısalık ve inatçı çekişkenliği şişmanlıkla birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda bedenin dolgunlaşıp yağlanmasını anlatır, boy ve huy koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Şişmanlık ve beden dolgunluğu anlam alanında iki dal buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üçlü bir kişi niteliğidir; komşu dal yalnız bedensel dolgunluğu seçer ve farklı canlı türlerine de uygulanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kısa ve toplu kişi betimi ile genel beden dolgunluğu, üç niteliğin birlikte bulunması koşulunu en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل بمعنى اجتماع القصر والسمن واللجاج في وصف الشخص.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه قصر النخل ولا الدويبة المسماة جعلا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل القصر مع السمن واللجاج (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir şeyi var etme, bir duruma sokma, adlandırma ve eyleme başlama gibi eylem anlamlarından; iş karşılığı, küçük hurma ağacı, tencere bezi, küçük yer hayvanı, dişinin eş istemesi, deve kuşu yavrusu, yer adı ve birleşik kişi betimi gibi birbirinden uzak ad alanlarına yayılır. Bu dallar tek bir çağdaş çekirdeğe indirgenemeyen belirgin bir çok anlamlılık oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği açık ve anlaşılır anlatımın, işitilebilir sesin ya da beklenen yanıtın yokluğu olarak kuruyor. Konuşmasını açıkça anlatamayan kişi ile Arap olmayan kişi ya da topluluk aynı şey değildir; ilki anlatım yetisine, ikincisi topluluk aidiyetine göre adlandırılır. Hayvan, sessiz okunan ibadet, yanıtsız ev, güç anlaşılan iş ve sessiz dalga kullanımları bu çekirdeğin ayrı uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, dişle ısırmayı, meyve çekirdeğini ya da yazıya ayırıcı nokta koyma işlemini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın anlaşılmazlık çekirdeğini korur; kişi, topluluk, hayvan, ibadet, ev, kapı, iş ve dalga kullanımlarını yalnızca kendi kalıpları içinde ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Açık anlatımın, anlaşılır sesin veya beklenen yanıtın bulunmaması yüzünden sözün, varlığın ya da durumun kendini belli etmemesidir. Bu çekirdek; açık konuşamayan kişi, Arap olmayan topluluk, konuşamayan hayvan, sessiz okuma, yanıtsız ev, çözülmesi güç iş ve ses çıkarmayan dalga gibi farklı uygulamalara uzanır.

facets.statement: Söz, ses veya yanıt açık biçimde ortaya çıkmadığı için anlaşılma gerçekleşmez.
Açık konuşamayan kişi anlatımına göre, Arap olmayan kişi veya topluluk ise köken ve aidiyetine göre adlandırılır.
Konuşamayan hayvan, sessiz okunan ibadet, yanıt vermeyen ev, kapalı ya da güç iş ve ses çıkarmayan dalga aynı yokluk üzerinden nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, açık anlatım ve anlaşılır ses yokluğunu ortak çekirdek sayar; kişi ve topluluk adlarını birbirinden ayırırken hayvan, ibadet, ev, kapı, iş ve dalga kullanımlarını da kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: açık anlatımın, anlaşılır sesin veya yanıtın yokluğu
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın söz, ses ve yanıt eksikliğine dayanan ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen çekirdek anlamı eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin sözünü açık ve anlaşılır biçimde söyleyemediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye özgü anlatım yetersizliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Okumanın işitilmediği, bir yerden yanıt gelmediği ya da bir varlığın ses çıkarmadığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ses ve yanıt yokluğunu bağlama uygun biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalında söz, ses veya yanıt kendini açıkça belli etmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda yazı harfleri ayırıcı noktalarla belirginleştirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir biçimin alıcı tarafından ayırt edilmesi veya edilememesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı konuşma, ses veya yanıttaki açıklık yokluğunu bildirir; komşu dal yazıdaki belirsizliği ayırıcı işaret koyarak giderir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; en belirgin sınır, anlaşılmazlık ile anlamı açıklığa çıkarma arasındaki karşıtlıktır.
branches.what_is_ar: العجمة والإعجام بمعنى خلاف الإبانة والإفهام، ويدخل فيه الأعجم في اللسان، والعجمي المنسوب إلى غير العرب، والعجماء التي لا تنطق، والصلاة التي لا يسمع فيها قراءة، والدار أو الأمر أو الباب إذا استبهم أو سكت جوابه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العض بالأضراس، ولا النوى، ولا الصلابة المجردة، ولا تعجيم الخط بالنقط من حيث هو علامة مكتوبة
branches.source_phrase_ar: العجمة خلاف الإبانة (mufradat)؛ أحدها يدل على سكوت وصمت (maqayis)؛ الأعجم الذي لا يفصح (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العجم ضد العرب (ayn;sihah;mufradat)؛ العجماء البهيمة لأنها لا تتكلم (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ صلاة النهار عجماء (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ استعجمت الدار عن جواب السائل (maqayis;ayn;mufradat)؛ باب معجم مبهم (mufradat)؛ قفل معجم وأمر معجم إذا اعتاص (tahdhib)؛ الأعجم من الموج الذي لا يتنفس (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı kullanımı açıkça destekliyor: yazıdaki benzer harfleri noktalarla ayırt etme işlemi ve bu düzen içinde tek tek belirlenen yazı harfleri. Dalın çerçevesi, konuşmadaki anlaşılmazlıktan farklı olarak görsel yazı işaretlerine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal konuşma güçlüğünü değil, yazıdaki harfleri ayıran noktalama işlemini ve yazı harflerini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yazı ve harf alanıyla sınırlıdır; konuşma, ısırma veya başka kalıplara ait anlamlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Benzer yazı harflerinin karışmasını önlemek için onlara ayırıcı noktalar veya işaretler koyma işlemidir. Aynı ad, bu yolla birbirinden belirgin hale getirilen ayrı yazı harfleri bütünü için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Yazıdaki harfler, ayırt edilmelerini sağlayan noktalar veya işaretlerle belirginleştirilir.
Ad, birbirinden ayrılmış tek tek yazı veya alfabe harfleri bütünü için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, yazıyı noktalarla belirginleştirme işlemi ile bu düzende ayrılan tek tek harfleri ortak biçimde kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: harfleri ayırt etmek için yazıyı noktalama
concept_gloss.applicability: Yazıdaki benzer harfleri ayırıcı işaretlerle belirginleştiren temel işlemi karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ayırıcı işaret koyma işlemini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir metindeki harf biçimlerini noktalarla birbirinden ayırma bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yazıya nokta koyarak ayrım sağlama işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek tek ayrılan yazı harflerinin bütünü kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı yazı harfleri bütününü doğal biçimde karşılar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yazıyı ayırt etmek için harfleri noktalamak

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözün, sesin veya yanıtın açık ve anlaşılır olmamasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir biçimin alıcı tarafından ayırt edilmesi veya edilememesi söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yazıdaki belirsizliği işaret ekleyerek giderir; komşu dal ise konuşma, ses veya yanıt düzeyindeki belirsizliği ve sessizliği bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: تعجيم الكتاب والخط والحرف بالنقط أو العلامة التي تكشف التباس الحروف، وحروف المعجم من جهة كونها حروف الخط أو الحروف المقطعة
